question: Where should the round question sit, and how big? All four show the same long sample question.

variants.label: Today: tier, one line
variants.changes: Control. 14px in the round tier, cut off with an ellipsis; the full text only in a tooltip.

variants.label: Tier wraps
variants.changes: Same place, but the tier grows to fit: 16px medium, wraps to as many lines as needed, component as a pill in front.

variants.label: Question heads the page
variants.changes: The tier keeps arrows, round id, component and progress. The question moves to the top of the page as a 24px heading above the badges. It scrolls away with the page.

variants.label: Question by the answer
variants.changes: The tier keeps arrows, round id, component and progress. The question sits at 16px on top of the floating answer bar, always on screen, right where you pick and type the reason.
